Diego Alvarez
Backend Engineer, Austin TX
diego.alvarez@example.com

Summary
Backend engineer with 5 years of experience building healthcare and fintech APIs.

Skills
Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS

Experience

Backend Engineer at Cardinal Fintech (2023 to 2026)
Designed and shipped payment APIs in Python and FastAPI handling 40 million requests a month.
Modeled ledger data in PostgreSQL with strict audit constraints.
Cut p95 latency in half with Redis caching on hot read paths.
Packaged services with Docker and deployed them on AWS ECS.

Software Engineer at Mesa Labs (2021 to 2023)
Built lab report ingestion pipelines in Python.
Owned the PostgreSQL schema for sample tracking.

Education
BS Software Engineering, UT Austin, 2021
